patches.name: Uncensor patch
patches.notes: Install (PC): Open the Steam game install folder (right click the game in Steam, Properties, Local Files, Browse Local Files...) Download the patch archive from the link below Extract the patch archive onto your computer Run "noble_rose_patch_v1.exe" and select your Steam game install folder (from Step 1) when asked to Select Destination Location It's working if: The main menu has an image of Magical Girl Noble Rose on it, and when in combat there is images of both Rose and the combatant. uncensorpat.ch checked this patch on PC.
